_about: The Imperium - Adeptus Custodes catalogue as verify/from-bsdata.js reads it from BSData (wh40k-11e at the pin) with GW’s datasheets over it (verify/from-json.js): every current datasheet (no Legends, no Crusade, no Crucible: verify/bs-catalog.js FILTER), one DATASHEETS row each. Written by `node verify/from-bsdata.js adeptus-custodes --write`; verify/tables.js --write puts every row into DATASHEETS (a row a list has keeps the list’s signed-off facts, and gets the catalogue’s rows it lacks); the gate step catalog (verify/catalog.js) checks it is what the sources give. Do not edit.
